asr.full_text: hello everyone and this is Shah and doge is now trading around 0.096 the chart is sitting at a very important technical level because the market is trying to decide whether this move is the beginning of a stronger breakout or just another temporary reaction before the previous trend resumes in the last update price had moved just under the resistance around 0.095 and at that point the setup was looking weak because buyers were struggling to push through that ceiling. The expectation at that time was for DOGE to face rejection from that resistance and begin moving lower, toward the next support zone. At that moment, the structure was still favoring sellers because every push higher was being absorbed near the same resistance level. The market had not shown enough strength to break above it and the momentum was slowly starting to lean to the downside. But before the bearish setup could fully develop, the entire market reacted to the news about the extended ceasefire. That headline changed sentiment very quickly. And once Bitcoin and the larger market started moving higher doge followed the same wave of buying pressure. As a result, price pushed back above the resistance level that had previously been holding the market down. That move above 0.095 is important because when price breaks above a level that has repeatedly acted as resistance it can sometimes signal that market sentiment is beginning to change. Buyers are showing that they are willing to step in at higher prices and sellers are no longer able to defend the same zone with the same strength. On the surface, that looks bullish, but there is still one major problem. The breakout has not been confirmed yet. Right now, DOGE is only trading above that resistance on an intraday basis and in crypto that alone is not enough many news driven moves can look strong in the moment but once the emotional reaction fades the market can quickly reverse that is why the next two daily candles matter so much for this breakout to become reliable dodge needs at least two daily candlecloths is above zero point. Zero nine five without that confirmation This move still carries the risk of turning into a false breakout a false breakout happens When price moves above resistance attracts buyers into the market and then suddenly falls back below that same level When that happens late buyers get trapped and the market often moves lower with more force. Since this recent move was triggered by external news rather than pure technical momentum, that possibility still needs to be respected. Markets can reverse just as quickly if opposite headlines appear. If buyers can hold DOGE above 0.095 for multiple daily closes, then the break out becomes much stronger. That would show the old resistance is turning into support and that would open the path toward the next major target around 0.10. That level is important, because it is both a psychological resistance and a technical level, where the market could slow down again. Reaching that zone would confirm that buyers are starting to regain control. Join shaha.com for free signals, and let me know which coin you want me to cover next.
